project.name: pux4j :: Native Image Builds
project.description:
GraalVM native image builds for pux4j applications. Depends on the pux4j JVM artifacts: build and install the pux4j project first.
Invocation requires two profiles: one app profile and one target profile. mvn package -P smoke,hat-2in9v2 (aarch64 cross-compile) mvn package -P validation,hat-2in13v4 (aarch64 cross-compile) mvn package -P demo,x86_64 (x86_64 native, no sysroot, emulator driver) mvn package -P dice-demo,x86_64 (as above, dice demo)
Each image contains exactly ONE application. The base dependencies hold no application module; every app profile declares its own, and Maven Enforcer rules in the app and target profiles fail the build if another application, the emulator (on a HAT build) or a second HAT driver reaches the dependency tree or the module-path directory.
For aarch64 targets the sysroot property must also be set (done by the deploy script): mvn package -P smoke,hat-2in9v2 -Dsysroot=/path/to/aarch64/sysroot
